book.name: Matyu
book.title: God tal ol na tongwo ha maing yal Matyu mining bongwo dimia.

content: Yon ha maing nir bil tongwo yal i gongwo
Ena yu ongwo gin irawe, Galili ganba singaba Herot Yisas tal ongwo i haang pungwi.
Pirere, gamahobo yu ditongwi, “Yon ha maing nir bil tongwo yal irai, gongworai, ti si hon ere aire tal yu oma dimua,” dungwi.
Homa yasingaba Herot ebering Pilip eumbi al Herotias ingwi.
Ingwo iwe, Yon hanere, “Ni al i inga i nigi domua,” di te te ole mongwi.
Mongure, Herot yong ki ere Yon si golala di pimba, Yuda ari Yon God hana togu yal momiraya dire, kul pungwi.
Ena Herot aang kul nongwo kalanda si engwo haung u tibi omia, Herot hanere, homena ke ne mongwi. Ne mongure al Herotias aung pi arihobi mongwo bani egin gale ingwi.
Imiawe, Herot wai hanere, ama i yu ditongwi, “Ni egin ingi wai weni hania, tal ta irala di pinanga, na di na to. Di na tenangi ha weni kara ni teralua.”
Dungure, aang ama i gala dire, “Yon halibusi pangworai, breng biire pera ali ere i na to ditenana po” ditongwi. Ditongwo ama i pirere Herot mongwo bani pirere aang dungwo meri ditongwi.
Ditomia Herot nigi de pimba, ari mongwo bani ha weni kara diraya ama dungwo meri yu olalua dire, gamahobo tau bai nu si halabusi oo malgi olungwi.
Olemia, pirere Yon breng biire i pera ali ere i ure ama i tongwi.
Tongure ama i, i pirere aang tongwi.
Yu omia Yon grang wine ongwo tau halabusi oo ala pirere, Yon yone i ure man wu engwi. Wu erere pi Yisas mongwo bani pire ha i di tibi ol tongwi.
Yisas ari 5,000 homena tongwo ha
Ol tomia, Yisas pirere, mongwo bani aidolere, u sipi ala pirere, pi sina ering gobo ta nin muru molala dire ongwi. Ongure, ari hobi omua dungwo pungwi.
Pirere, nir bina doling bol ongwi. Ongure, Yisas sipi ala mole ere mena ure, arihobi miki weni hanere, miling pir tongwi. Pir terere, nu nibil pangwo hobi awai ol tongwi.

Ol tere mongure, hamen pudungure, grang wine ongwo hobi Yisas mongwo bani ure yu ditongwi, “Omaga ganba po engwo bani molala di ungarai, hamen girangwo pamia, ari hobi ditengere, oo hona hona tau pirere, homena bring sinamia, nu si olo”.
Dimba, Yisas yu dungwi, “A, monamia. Ni yalhobi nin homena ta i unanga, obil tenana pio.”
Dungure grang wine ongwo hobi yu ditongwi, “Breti ana hol pai muru pisi sutani i umingirawe”.
Dimba, Yisas, “O dinangwo i, obil ire na mominga baniya wo,” dungwi.

Direre, ari hobi kul bongwo bani “ami dio.” Diterere, homena breti pisi kina ereho irere, hamen bani yuwo hanere, “O God homena na tengi wai piriwa” dungwi. Direre, breti a du dire grang wine ongwo hobi tongwi. Tongure, yalhobi ire ebir sire ari mongwo hobi tongwi.
Tongure ari hobi nere miing ongwi. Ena homena tau ya dungwo tali i ku bolere, gal basket ana holo holo kebena sutani girungwi.
Te ari homena ne mongwo hobi iwe, paib tausen miki weni ne momia, gir migi agr para kerekimna.
Yisas nir aulung bani hol wangwo ha
Ena, Yisas grang wine ongwo hobi bai nu si olungure, sipi ala pirere, nir digan bina hol bani ongwi.
Ongure Yisas ari hobi “ere po,” ditongwi. Ditere, Yisas hamen hul ta pire, irang God kina hawai olala di pire ongwi.

Pi molere, hamen girimia, nin mongwi. Nin mongwo haung i, grang wine ongwo hobi sipi ala molere, ere pi nir digan sina weni pa dungwi. Pa dungure, hamen hair mu dinba urere, sipi si manala olala dire ongwi.
Ongure, girungwo sinamoki grang wine ongwo hobi mongwo bani Yisas nir barere u pa dungwi.
Dimia grang wine ongwo hobi hanere, kul pirere, “Aya, kwia ta umua,” dire, gala dungwo oba abe yangure mongwi.
Momba, Yisas hanere, “A, yu olkire, mining bole molo.
Na Yisas uminia ara uma di pine?” Ditongure Pita di holo ol tere, “Yal Yisas ye, ni nin unanga, na nir bare wo di na tenanga urale?”.
Dungure Yisas “Owa nir bare wo.” Ditongure Pita nir bare Yisas mongwo bani ongwi.
Omba, hamen hair bir hon hanere, u di nir ali ongwi.
Pirere gala bir dire, “Aki di na tekino”. Dungure Yisas gintani urere, Pita aki dungwi. Aki dire yu ditongwi, “Ni nir bare ungi na yulana ni teralga paikinama di pino? Talongwo na pir na tekine?”
Direre, iri si sipi ala ongwi.
Ongure hamen hair wai sungwi. Wai simia gamahobo Yisas maa e tere. “Ni onga wai piminua. Ni God wang weni monga pamua,” ditongwi.
Yisas Genesaret ganba bani pire ari nibil pangwo miki weni awai ol tongwo ha
Ena Yisas gamahobo kina hon ere pirere, pi Genesaret ganba pa dungwi. Pa dungure, Genesaret arihobi Yisas gumang han pa dungwi.
Pa dire, bina holo holi nu nibil pare moli ongwo hobi, aule ire, Yisas mongwo bani ungwi.
Ure sirin bole yu ditongwi, “Nibil pangwo hobi ni galsina anamba?” Dungure nibil pangwo hobi galsina arere, u wai ongwi.
